name: Print Studio Notes
summary: A portfolio identity that uses the visual language of a print studio to explain a newcomer’s first visit and the design decisions behind it.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 10 / title.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 10 / footer.

recognitionRules: Use Futura display titles with clear Arial case narration.
Keep primary blue, red and yellow accents against warm paper.
Give the prototype artifact a prominent place rather than replacing it with abstract diagrams.
Keep the brief, constraint and proposed response in a readable sequence.

principles: Name the work and the contribution before describing personal qualities.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Help someone begin making. Show the choices that make beginning easier.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid unsupported expertise labels and turning prototypes into shipped outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: I made this part; the team decided what happened next.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use PRINT STUDIO NOTES in Futura with three small offset registration-like bars. Do not copy actual printer registration marks as certification.
invariants: Use Futura display titles with clear Arial case narration.
Keep primary blue, red and yellow accents against warm paper.
Give the prototype artifact a prominent place rather than replacing it with abstract diagrams.
adaptations: A portfolio cover may use all three accents; evidence pages use one at a time.
Retain prototype status beside the artifact.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Futura is an Apple/system or separately licensed font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
